assertions.statement: The landing page explains the three lanes (Instant, Timelock, Approval) and shows a live Chainlink HBAR/USD price.
assertions.howToVerify: Open /. Confirm three lane cards are visible and a price like '1 ℏ = $0.0…' with 'Chainlink' appears near the top.

assertions.statement: A connected owner can create a funded vault and open its dashboard.
assertions.howToVerify: Connect the burner wallet, scroll to 'Your vaults', enter 5 and click 'Create with ℏ'. A new tile appears; clicking it opens /vault/<address> showing a balance of about 5 ℏ.

assertions.statement: The owner can authorise an agent with USD limits and the card shows the worst-case daily exposure.
assertions.howToVerify: On the vault page fill 'Authorise an agent' with any 0x address and the default limits, submit, and confirm an agent card with 'Worst case per day' appears.

assertions.statement: The owner can pause and resume all agents.
assertions.howToVerify: Click 'Pause all agents'; a 'Paused' badge appears. Click 'Resume all agents'; it disappears.
